responseTimeoutMs.description: Response timeout for read/write operations in milliseconds

defaultSendMode.description: Default send mode for frame encoding (hex = hex string, ascii = ASCII text, raw = raw bytes)

connectionSummary: Raw TCP message tunnel for private protocols and gateway debugging with HEX/ASCII send modes, timed auto-send, and CRC/LRC calculation.
connectionSteps: Fill in the target host and TCP port.
After the session is connected, send HEX, ASCII, or raw bytes directly.
Read actions wait for the next received frame without additional protocol parsing.
Use auto-send for periodic frame transmission at configurable intervals.
Append CRC-16/Modbus or LRC to frames for protocol compliance.
readBehavior: Read waits for the next incoming frame. Write forwards the encoded byte sequence. Supports hex, ascii, and raw send modes with optional CRC/LRC appending.
